filter.text: must be a non-empty UTF-8 string after whitespace-only eligibility check; original bytes are never trimmed or rewritten
filter.target_label: not derived from any source field, including role/review/rank/toxicity
filter.duplicate_rule: deduplicate exact UTF-8 response bytes by SHA-256 during stable selection
filter.tree_rule: select at most one message per message_tree_id and retain every node ID/parent edge and text hash for each selected tree
filter.length_rule: strict kev.model.encode with the pinned Phase 4 parent tokenizer and training_context(2048), including <state>

selection_algorithm: Sort eligible rows by SHA256(UTF8(revision + NUL + message_tree_id + NUL + message_id + NUL + response_sha256)), then message_tree_id, message_id, response_sha256; greedily accept the first row per tree with a unique exact response hash that strictly encodes within 2048 state tokens until 40 rows are selected.
